description: A periodic advisor review of a portfolio: weights, concentration (HHI and effective number of holdings), sector and asset-class exposure, drift from targets with the trades to rebalance, and, given return history, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown, VaR/CVaR and beta. Ends with prioritized findings. Price: $0.05.

rebalance_band.description: Absolute drift that triggers a rebalance, default 0.05.

targets.description: Target weights by symbol or asset_class, summing to 1.

name: portfolio_review
title: Portfolio review
